plugin_desc: Rittal CMC III SNMP child template for network-service rack, environment, power and monitoring units under Rittal PEN 2606.7 (RITTAL-CMC-III-MIB). Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. CMC-III variable-table rows are walked from cmcIIIVarTable (cmcIIIVarName, cmcIIIVarUnit, cmcIIIVarValueInt, optional cmcIIIVarValueStr) and normalized by unit and name into env_temperature_celsius, env_humidity_percent, pdu_active_power_watts and pdu_current_amps. Exact sensor names vary by configuration, so row indexes are never assumed. CPU and memory scalars are not invented. CMC-III control and command trees are not collected. Supported brands/models - Rittal CMC III units that expose RITTAL-CMC-III-MIB under PEN 2606.7 and standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Per-sensor environment temperature in degrees Celsius, mapped from cmcIIIVarTable rows whose unit is degree C and whose name matches a temperature reading. Exact names vary by sensor configuration; row indexes are never assumed. Setpoint, hysteresis and description rows are excluded.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Per-sensor relative humidity in percent, mapped from cmcIIIVarTable rows whose unit is % or percent and whose name matches a humidity reading. Exact names vary by sensor configuration; row indexes are never assumed. Setpoint, hysteresis and description rows are excluded.

metrics.name: pdu_active_power_watts
metrics.description: PDU active power in watts, mapped from cmcIIIVarTable rows whose unit is W and whose name matches a power reading. Exact names vary by sensor configuration; row indexes are never assumed. Setpoint, hysteresis and description rows are excluded.

metrics.name: pdu_current_amps
metrics.description: PDU current in amperes, mapped from cmcIIIVarTable rows whose unit is A and whose name matches a current reading. Exact names vary by sensor configuration; row indexes are never assumed. Setpoint, hysteresis and description rows are excluded.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
